audience: companies in Chile that run their sales, inventory and accounting in Laudus ERP

useCases.title: Review unpaid invoices and credit limits
useCases.text: The AI lists the unpaid sales invoices of one customer or all customers, and checks how much of a customer's credit limit is used.

useCases.title: Break down sales by salesperson or product
useCases.text: The AI totals invoiced sales for a date range, grouped by salesperson, customer, product, category, month or branch.

useCases.title: Check stock and stock movements
useCases.text: The AI lists the warehouses, shows the stock of a product in each one, optionally as of a date, and lists its stock movements (kardex).

useCases.title: Read financial statements and the ledger
useCases.text: The AI pulls the balance sheet as of a date, the profit and loss statement for a period, and the general ledger of an account.

useCases.title: Review undelivered sales orders
useCases.text: The AI finds the sales orders not yet delivered, for one customer or a due-date range, and opens each with its lines.

useCases.title: Add a new customer
useCases.text: The AI checks by RUT that the customer is not in Laudus yet, then creates the customer record. No invoice is issued.
